turn_stall_recovery_notice.zh-CN: 模型生成流持续静默，Codex Mainline 已自动中断停滞 turn，并在同一上下文中恢复工作。
turn_stall_recovery_notice.en-US: The model stream stayed silent, so Codex Mainline interrupted the stalled turn and resumed work in the same context.

turn_stall_recovery_prompt.zh-CN: 【Codex Mainline】: 上一轮模型生成流在已有进展后持续静默，主线已中断该停滞 turn。请依据同一 thread 中的现有上下文和工作区状态，继续上一轮尚未完成的任务；先简短告知用户已自动恢复。
turn_stall_recovery_prompt.en-US: [Codex Mainline]: The previous model stream stayed silent after making progress, so the stalled turn was interrupted. Continue the unfinished task from the same thread context and workspace state; first briefly tell the user that automatic recovery succeeded.

turn_stall_input_prompt.zh-CN: 【Codex Mainline】: 上一轮模型生成流在已有进展后持续静默，主线已中断该停滞 turn。请优先处理下面这条用户消息，并结合现有上下文继续未完成工作。
turn_stall_input_prompt.en-US: [Codex Mainline]: The previous model stream stayed silent after making progress, so the stalled turn was interrupted. Prioritize the user message below and continue unfinished work using the current context.

turn_stall_recovery_failed_notice.zh-CN: 模型流静默恢复未能释放旧 turn，自动恢复已经停止。请发送 /stop 后继续。
turn_stall_recovery_failed_notice.en-US: Silent-stream recovery could not release the old turn and has stopped. Send /stop before continuing.

compaction_recovery_pause_prompt.zh-CN: 【Codex Mainline】: 上下文压缩失败，当前进入压缩恢复态。请暂停一切行动：不要读取文件，不要调用工具，不要推进任务，不要展开新分析；只简短确认“已暂停，等待上下文压缩恢复”。
compaction_recovery_pause_prompt.en-US: [Codex Mainline]: Context compaction failed and recovery mode is active. Pause all actions: do not read files, call tools, continue tasks, or start new analysis. Reply only with: paused, waiting for context compaction recovery.

compaction_recovery_resume_prompt.zh-CN: 【Codex Mainline】: Knock knock，从上下文压缩失败中恢复，压缩成功，需要继续任务。
compaction_recovery_resume_prompt.en-US: [Codex Mainline]: Knock knock. Context compaction recovered successfully; continue the task.

proactive_compaction_resume_prompt.zh-CN: 【Codex Mainline】: Knock knock，主动上下文压缩完成，需要继续压缩前的任务。
proactive_compaction_resume_prompt.en-US: [Codex Mainline]: Knock knock. Proactive context compaction completed; continue the task from before compaction.
